verdict: Wrong-hostname rejection, active UIDT task-removal continuity to exact completion, and scoped shell stop-app process-loss/reconciliation with automatic process return; no product readiness or actual Task Manager UI pass.
scopeBoundary: All observations are installed 0.4.1. Newer 0.4.2 source/audit changes were not installed during this run and acquire no device pass from it. Host and device timestamps are separate clocks. All control taps were injected, not physical-input tests.

archive.privacyBoundary: Contains private endpoint configuration and CA material; archive remains ignored/private, no member contents published.

fixture.boundary: Generated throttled payload; no throughput benchmark or packet-route claim.

wrongHostname.verdict: Valid trusted chain with mismatched endpoint identity; device failed SSLPeerUnverifiedException before any payload or logged HTTP request.

nativeTaskRemoval.boundary: Native caption close while running, later own task-record count 0 with process present. Same process and attempt progressed and completed; no final-Activity callback or general survival policy inferred.

latestExitDiagnostic.boundary: Shell subreason observed on this build; not a public application API.

shellStopTest.boundary: No stop callback was persisted. Null stopReason/stopOutcome does not prove callbacks never occurred. No request replay observed through frozen server log; process restart is not transfer restart. No promise that process stays stopped.

uiReturn.boundary: Failed helper did not tap or establish a missing app control. Subsequent fresh active-app layout and matched Open transfer action produced the interrupted screen.

artifactNamingBoundary: batch-02-attempt-02-final-* was still running, not completion evidence. Only completion-journal/observation/payload supply terminal completion; early result for attempt1 was queued, so settled evidence is used.
notEstablished: Actual native Task Manager UI workflow or all UIDT user-stop semantics
Cause of automatic process restart and absence of any callback
LAN revocation/denied-socket OS enforcement, assigned-network changes, deadline/exhausted budgets
Natural low-memory, reboot/power-loss, indefinite background reliability
Physical keyboard/mouse/touch/IME or full platform acceptance
reviewStatus: Accepted by primary and independent reviewers: selected hashes, all eight archive members, journal/host projections, payloads, own-control bounds, stop samples and cleanup checked; no actionable finding.
sanitization: Allowlisted probe observations and file path/size/hash metadata only. No raw UI, screenshots, shell dumps, private endpoint/address/hostname/user identifiers, OS PID/UID, configuration values, certificates or keys are published.
